name: Phone Label
description: Adds an optional label to a telephone field: a new 'phone_label' field type (extending core telephone) that stores a title alongside the number, with a matching widget and a tel: link formatter.
project_description: Phone Label provides a 'Labelled telephone number' field type that extends Drupal core's telephone field with an optional title/label stored next to the number. It ships three plugins: the field type PhoneLabelItem (adds a 'title' string property and a per-field 'Allow label override' setting of Disabled/Optional/Required), the widget phone_label_default (adds a label textfield plus a label-placeholder setting on top of core's telephone widget), and the formatter phone_label ('Telephone link with label') that renders each value as a tel: link using the label as link text, falling back to the number. It has no configuration page, no routes, no permissions, and no services; the label is chosen at field-creation time as a distinct field type rather than a setting on core's telephone field.
